page_desc: Whether you want to start a business yourself, or you are an organisation helping others do it — we have a programme for you.
individuals_heading: A step-by-step path to starting your business.
individuals_desc: Our programmes are for people who are done thinking about starting and ready to actually do it. Most of our participants are busy. They have jobs, families, and limited time. Our structure is built around that reality.
accelerator_desc: Learn everything you need to start a business — on your own time, at your own pace. Pre-recorded video lessons that walk you through every step, from testing your idea to getting your first paying client.
dwy_desc: Build your business with an experienced founder right beside you. This is hands-on. You will be coached, challenged, and held to account every week — from your first idea through to your first paying client.
dfy_desc: You have the idea. We do the rest. Our team builds your entire business from the ground up and hands it to you ready to operate. No guesswork. No learning curve. Just a business that works.
organisations_desc: We partner with universities, local authorities, government agencies, charities, prisons, and corporate organisations to help people at the earliest stages of enterprise build and launch their first business.
partners_heading: Clear delivery. Measurable results. Proper reporting.
cta_heading: Ready to talk about a programme for your community?
cta_desc: Tell us who you are trying to help, what you want to achieve, and when you need it. We will come back to you with a proposal.
individuals_section_heading: Build your business with structure, clarity, and accountability.
individuals_section_desc: Our programmes are built for people who are ready to move from thinking about starting a business to actually building one. Many of our participants have jobs, families, and limited time.
p1_title: We Teach You How to Build It
p1_desc: A structured, on-demand programme delivering practical business education you can complete alongside existing commitments. Pre-recorded video curriculum covering every stage from validating your idea to acquiring your first client.
p1_learn_1: How to validate a business idea and identify a market willing to pay
p1_learn_2: How to design an offer that solves a real problem at a price people accept
p1_learn_3: How to sell with confidence — even if you have never sold before
p1_learn_4: How to build a lead generation system that works with limited time and budget
p1_learn_5: How to set up the operational foundations of a real, functioning business
p1_for_1: People with a business idea who need structure to make it real
p1_for_2: Anyone tired of consuming content that never leads to action
p1_for_3: People with limited time who need a focused, practical path they can follow in short bursts
p1_leave_1: A validated business concept with a defined target market
p1_leave_2: A complete offer ready to take to market
p1_leave_3: Sales scripts and outreach frameworks you can use immediately
p1_leave_4: A marketing plan tailored to your situation and budget
p1_leave_5: A clear operational roadmap for your first 90 days
p2_title: We Help You Build It and Launch It
p2_desc: A comprehensive implementation programme where you build your business alongside an experienced founder. This is hands-on, guided execution. You will be coached, challenged, and held accountable every step of the way — from first concept through to first paying client.
p2_includes_1: Weekly live sessions with direct coaching and feedback
p2_includes_2: Daily accountability tracking and performance reviews
p2_includes_3: One-to-one support on your specific business challenges
p2_includes_4: Templated frameworks, scripts, and systems you implement as you go
p2_includes_5: A structured curriculum that builds week-on-week toward launch
p2_for_1: People who want hands-on guidance, not just information
p2_for_2: Anyone committed to launching within the programme window
p2_for_3: People who know they need accountability to follow through
p2_leave_1: A launched and operating business — not a plan, an actual business
p2_leave_2: Paying clients acquired during the programme
p2_leave_3: Tested sales processes and proven outreach systems
p2_leave_4: A 90-day growth plan for continued momentum after graduation
p2_leave_5: Ongoing access to the Mind and Method community
p3_title: We Build and Launch It for You
p3_does_1: Register your business and set up the legal foundations
p3_does_2: Build your brand, website, and online presence
p3_does_3: Create your offer, pricing, and sales materials
p3_does_4: Set up and run paid advertising to get your first clients
p3_does_5: Connect you with accountants, legal support, and business finance
p3_for_1: People who want a business but do not have the time to build it themselves
p3_for_2: People who want to skip the learning curve and start with a running operation
p3_for_3: People who are ready to invest in having it done properly from day one
p3_leave_2: A complete brand and online presence
p3_leave_3: A tested offer with paying clients
p3_leave_4: Advertising systems running and generating leads
p3_leave_5: Full handover with everything you need to operate independently
organisations_heading: Implementation programmes built for the communities you serve.
sector_universities: Enterprise education, employability programmes, and founder development workshops — particularly for widening participation backgrounds.
sector_councils: Self-employment support, economic regeneration, and workforce development for communities where traditional employment pathways are limited.
sector_charities: Enterprise programmes for young people, refugees, people leaving care, or communities facing economic disadvantage.
sector_prisons: Building practical business skills, self-efficacy, and a structured pathway toward self-employment upon release.
sector_schools: Age-appropriate entrepreneurship workshops for secondary school and sixth-form students from underrepresented backgrounds.
sector_corporate: Career-transition support, intrapreneurship training, and community impact programmes.
expect_1: Participants leave with a tested idea and a path to self-employment
expect_2: Weekly progress tracking — you see exactly what gets built
expect_3: Impact report with outcome data ready for funders and stakeholders
expect_4: Built to produce revenue, not just attendance
expect_5: Tailored to your objectives, your learners, and your context
expect_6: MBA-qualified practitioner with 10+ years building businesses across three continents
expect_7: Workbooks, frameworks, and branded materials all included
expect_8: Proven curriculum built around what makes or breaks a new business
partners_section_heading: Structured delivery. Measurable outcomes. Clear reporting.
